implementationMessage: Sites v11 is deployed. Production live-status data returns structured results for the three configured NIJISANJI channels, repeated requests use the server cache, the known Kuzuha channel resolves successfully, and a non-NIJISANJI channel is rejected.
safetyMessage: SAFE: production API checks passed. The YouTube credential remains in a Sites Secret and is read only by Worker server code; response inspection found no key/secret fields. The runtime does not use search.list, batches channels.list/videos.list, caches refreshes, deduplicates simultaneous work, preserves stale safe data on failures, and recent Worker error logs were empty.
